statements: Ketman assesses m8s-lab and HyperbuildX as linked GitHub organization clusters used as credibility hubs, shared code stores, recruiter fronts, and amplification networks for suspected DPRK IT-worker personas. Public account relationships include reported renaming, cross-organization membership, mutual endorsements, and job-offer replies.
shared organization membership and cross-account following
recruiting or job-offer replies routed through the account network
Ketman assesses that GitHub organizations can serve as credibility hubs, shared code stores, recruiter fronts and amplification networks for suspected DPRK IT-worker personas.

The report names m8s-lab and HyperbuildX as assessed DPRK-operated organization clusters and describes copied repositories, inflated stars/followers, coordinated endorsements, account renaming and job-offer replies as cluster-level signals.
The source links public accounts across the two organizations, but those handles should remain source-attributed review leads rather than asserted legal identities.
